name: returns the backend rate for a verified seller
fullName: useSellerCommissionRate returns the backend rate for a verified seller
description:
useSellerEarnings / useSellerCommissionRate — the seller money hooks behind the
Payments tab, Selling Insights and the listing payout estimate. Both read
GET /payouts/summary and must skip it entirely for guests and unverified sellers.
